sentences.text:
Roop Singh Parihar vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 7
February, 2025
 Neutral Citation No. 2025:Mphc-Gwl:2660
 1 
 In The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh

Before
 Hon'Ble Shri Justice Rajendra Kumar Vani

On The 7 th Of February, 2025
 Misc. Criminal Case No. 5481 of 2025
 Roop Singh Parihar
 Versus
 The State Of Madhya Pradesh
 Appearance:
 Shri Mukesh Sharma - Advocate for the applicant.
 Shri Saket Udeniya- Public Prosecutor for the respond
 Order

The applicant has filed this third application for grant of interim bail in connection with Crime No.375/2024 registered at Police Station Kotwali, District Shivpuri(M.P.) for the offence punishable under Sections 420, 409, 467, 468, 471, 120-B of IPC and Section 13(1)(A) of Prevention of Corruption Act.

It is submitted by the counsel for the applicant that the son of applicant is suffering from Harniya and his operation is going to be held on 08.02.2025, therefore, he prays for grant of interim bail.
Learned Public Prosecutor for the State submits the fact of operation of son of the applicant is verified and the operation is going to be held on 08.02.2025.

Thus, looking to the facts and circumstances of the case including the fact that the son of applicant is suffering from Harniyta and he has to NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-GWL:2660 2 MCRC-5481-2025 undergo operation on 08.02.2025, this Court deems it fit to grant interim bail to the applicant for two days from the date of his release and accordingly interim bail is hereby allowed and it is hereby directed that applicant shall be released on interim bail from the date of receipt of certified copy of this order, on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.1,00,000/- (Rupees One Lac only) with a local solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the Court concerned.

The applicant shall positively surrender before the trial Court on 10.02.2025 before 5 P.M., failing which, the trial court shall be at liberty to take the applicant in custody forthwith.
